text: This report responds to a Motion by North York Community Council requesting the Manager, Land and Property Surveys to investigate and report to the next meeting of North York Community Council on the suitability of naming the public lane located north of Eglinton Avenue West and extending west from Dufferin Street as "Fairbank Village Lane". The lane extends between Fairbank Avenue and Shortt Street. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
North York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Fairbank Village Lane" for a public lane north of Eglinton Avenue West between Fairbank Avenue and Shortt Street.
